reviews.title: What an embarrassing fall off
reviews.text:
This app used to be very useful. As a content creator that posts every day, I saw value in using said app.

Recently everytime I tried to use it, it would make me log in EVERY SINGLE TIME. It kicks you off login the second you close the app. This is a hashtag app, it should not do that. Paying a subscription to an app that has outdated hashtags, does not give you personalized analytics and has terrible log in services is not worth the time or money. 

As a user that used this app for over 4 years I am extremely disappointed.

I also think the owner got his feelings hurt because this morning I could not log in at all. After I wrote a scathing support request. Embarrassing snd disappointing

Stay far away from this app.

reviews.title: Poor Execution and Support on TikTok
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app on Instagram for several years and was happy with its features. Since my move to TikTok, I found a number of issues with this app.

While in TikTok mode, the app finds relevant hashtags to my query, but it does not deliver those hashtags when I copy and paste. There is no way to copy the hashtags unless I screenshot it manually type them into my notes. Also, the app does not include my saved hashtags in the query results.

I don’t like leaving bad reviews, but I have emailed support over the years and never received a response. Hopefully this will get their attention and correct the issues that have Long plugged this app.

reviews.title: Worst mistake downloading this app
reviews.text: I made a huge mistake by downloading this app. It seems as though you’re set up to sign up for a 3 day trial period since I couldn’t get past that screen to even see what the app had to offer. I used the app for maybe 15min or less on day 1 of the 3 day trial. And then forgot all about the app upon being notified of my mother’s unexpected death. Several days after the trial was over and no success attempting to extract $89.99 from any account that I have because I’m a homeless welfare recipient. But after a loved one blessed me with $100 to help with my mother’s burial - Hashtag Expert claimed $89.99 and Apple refuses to refund the money. Telling me I have no recourse. Who owns this app? Can I ask them, rather BEG for a refund? I don’t want a yearly subscription I cannot afford it. I’m sorry for even downloading the app. The mistake is costing me - I can’t afford food, shelter, nothing. Please refund $89.99

reviews.title: Great App for beginners
reviews.text: I just started using this app after several weeks of posting content for my dog on TikTok and realized I needed some help.  This app not only tells you the best times to post and to not post but also provides you with relevant information to help guide you on the path to success. So whether you’re new to TikTok, Instagram, etc or are a seasoned pro, this app is very helpful.  I highly recommend.
